world.title: Survey on COVID-19 smell loss reveals over 50% of respondents still have symptoms after 5 years
world.description: Since the early stages of the COVID-19 pandemic, researchers at Virginia Commonwealth University's School of Medicine have maintained a national database of patients affected by COVID-19-related smell loss. Their latest survey shows that more than half of respondents are still impacted by smell dysfunction five years after initial infection.

world.title: Colorful fish reveal how species stay distinct despite interbreeding
world.description: Vividly colored fish dwelling at the bottom of shallow Midwestern streams may help biologists understand the evolutionary mechanisms by which species remain distinct despite their similarities and overlapping ranges. Orangethroat and rainbow darters regularly interbreed where their ranges overlap, yet—millions of years after they first diverged—they remain separate species.
